## BindingSource  (type-only)
type BindingSource =
{
    key: string;
}
 | {
    mouse: number;
}
 | {
    wheel: 1 | -1;
}
 | {
    padButton: number;
    pad?: number;
    threshold?: number;
}
 | {
    padAxis: number;
    dir: 1 | -1;
    pad?: number;
    threshold?: number;
}
 | {
    gesture: GestureKind;
}
 | {
    pointer: PointerButton;
}
 | {
    xr: XrButton;
    hand?: Hand;
}
 | {
    chord: readonly Binding[];
};

};

## Look
class Look {
    readonly look: {
        dx: number;
        dy: number;
    };
    readonly move: {
        x: number;
        y: number;
    };
    zoom: number;
    readonly stick: LookStick;
    locked: boolean;
    blocked: () => boolean;
    keyHeld: ((code: string) => boolean) | null;
    sensitivity: number;
    padSensitivity: number;
    invertY: boolean;
    moveZone: MoveZone;
    deadzone: number;
    radius: number;
    touchSensitivity: number | undefined;
    padDeadzone: number;
    keys: LookKeys;
    zoomWheel: boolean;
    zoomPinch: boolean;
    zoomPad: LookZoomPad;
    zoomStepPx: number;
    gyro: GyroSource | null;
    tapMaxMove: number;
    tapMaxMs: number;
    pointerTransform: PointerTransform | null;
    readonly clock: InputClock;
    orbitFromInput: boolean;
    padsFromInput: (() => readonly (GamepadLike | null)[]) | null;
    constructor(opts?: LookOptions);
    onTap(fn: LookTapListener): () => void;
    get mode(): LookMode;
    setMode(mode: LookMode): void;
    claimsPointer(device: 'mouse' | 'touch' | 'pen'): boolean;
    get orbiting(): boolean;
    on<K extends keyof LookEvents>(type: K, fn: (payload: LookEvents[K]) => void): () => void;
    onLockChange(fn: (locked: boolean) => void): () => void;
    update(): void;
    mouseMove(dx: number, dy: number): void;
    orbitDown(x: number, y: number): void;
    orbitMove(x: number, y: number): void;
    orbitUp(): void;
    wheel(units: number): void;
    touchDown(id: number, x: number, y: number, inMoveZone: boolean): void;
    touchMove(id: number, x: number, y: number): void;
    touchUp(id: number): void;
    cancelAll(): void;

    age: number;
    inside: boolean;
    synthetic: boolean;
}

## PointerRecordDevice  (type-only)
type PointerRecordDevice = 'mouse' | 'touch' | 'pen';

## PointerRouter
class PointerRouter<T = unknown> {
    readonly screen: ScreenPointers;
    readonly pointers: RoutedPointer<T>[];
    primary: RoutedPointer<T> | null;
    blocked: () => boolean;
    selectAction: string;
    secondaryAction: string;
    constructor(opts?: PointerRouterOptions<T>);
    get camera(): RayCamera | null;
    set camera(c: RayCamera | (() => RayCamera | null) | null);
    get hit(): RayHit<T> | null;
    on<K extends keyof PointerRouterEvents<T>>(type: K, fn: (e: PointerRouterEvents<T>[K]) => void): () => void;
    addTester(t: HitTester<T>): () => void;
    addSource(s: PointerSource): () => void;
    mute(sources?: readonly PointerSource[]): () => void;
    unmute(): void;
    isMuted(source: PointerSource): boolean;
    setPointerTransform(fn: PointerTransform | null): void;
    setGestures(g: Gestures | null): void;
    attach(target: HTMLElement, dispatcher?: PointerDispatcher): void;
    detach(): void;
    held(button: PointerButton): boolean;
    fired(button: PointerButton): boolean;
    xrHeld(button: XrButton, hand?: Hand): boolean;
    xrFired(button: XrButton, hand?: Hand): boolean;
    update(): void;
    poll(): void;
    resolve(actions: PointerActions | null): void;
}

## PointerRouterEvents  (type-only)
interface PointerRouterEvents<T = unknown> {
    hit: PointerHitEvent<T>;
    hitEnd: PointerHitEvent<T>;
    select: PointerHitEvent<T>;
    secondary: PointerHitEvent<T>;
    moved: PointerHitEvent<T>;
    released: PointerHitEvent<T>;
}

## PointerRouterOptions  (type-only)
interface PointerRouterOptions<T = unknown> {
    camera?: RayCamera | (() => RayCamera | null) | null;
    testers?: readonly HitTester<T>[];
    sources?: readonly PointerSource[];
    selectAction?: string;
    secondaryAction?: string;
    blocked?: () => boolean;
}

## PointerSample  (type-only)
interface PointerSample {
    key: number;
    device: PointerDevice;
    hand: Hand | null;
    readonly ray: Ray;
    x: number;
    y: number;
    select: boolean;
    secondary: boolean;
    xr: XrButtons | null;
    synthetic?: boolean;
}

## PointerSource  (type-only)
interface PointerSource {
    poll(camera: RayCamera | null): readonly PointerSample[];
    attach?(target: HTMLElement, dispatcher?: PointerDispatcher): void;
    detach?(): void;
}

## PointerState  (type-only)
interface PointerState {
    x: number;
    y: number;
    dx: number;
    dy: number;
    inside: boolean;
    down: boolean;
    wheelX: number;
    wheelY: number;
    type: 'mouse' | 'touch' | 'pen';
}

## PointerTransform  (type-only)
type PointerTransform = (clientX: number, clientY: number) => {
    x: number;
    y: number;
} | null;

## Ray  (type-only)
interface Ray {
    readonly origin: Vec3;
    readonly dir: Vec3;
}

## RayBounds  (type-only)
type RayBounds = MeshBounds;

## RayBox  (type-only)
interface RayBox<T = unknown> {
    min: readonly [number, number, number];
    max: readonly [number, number, number];
    target: T;
}

## RayCamera  (type-only)
type RayCamera = Pick<Camera, 'screen' | 'screenToWorld'>;

## RayHit  (type-only)
interface RayHit<T = unknown> {
    readonly point: Vec3;
    normal: Vec3 | null;
    distance: number;
    target: T;
}

## RayPlane  (type-only)
interface RayPlane {
    normal: readonly [number, number, number];
    offset?: number;
}

## RayTransform  (type-only)
type RayTransform = Pick<Transform, 'world'>;

## Rect  (type-only)
@deprecated
type Rect = Edges;

## RoutedPointer  (type-only)
interface RoutedPointer<T = unknown> {
    readonly source: PointerSource;
    readonly key: number;
    readonly device: PointerDevice;
    readonly hand: Hand | null;
    readonly x: number;
    readonly y: number;
    readonly ray: Ray;
    readonly select: boolean;
    readonly secondary: boolean;
    readonly xr: Readonly<XrButtons> | null;
    readonly hit: RayHit<T> | null;
}

## RumbleOptions  (type-only)
interface RumbleOptions {
    strong?: number;
    weak?: number;
    ms?: number;
    pad?: number;
}

## ScreenPointers
class ScreenPointers implements PointerSource {
    claim: ((id: number) => boolean) | null;
    setPointerTransform(fn: PointerTransform | null): void;
    setGestures(g: Gestures | null): void;
    pointerDown(id: number, x: number, y: number, device?: Contact['device'], button?: number, synthetic?: boolean): void;
    pointerMove(id: number, x: number, y: number, device?: Contact['device'], synthetic?: boolean): void;
    pointerUp(id: number, x: number, y: number, button?: number): void;
    pointerLeave(id: number): void;
    pointerCancel(id: number): void;
    cancelAll(): void;
    poll(camera: RayCamera | null): readonly PointerSample[];
    attach(target: HTMLElement, dispatcher?: PointerDispatcher): void;
    detach(): void;
}

type StickShape = 'radial' | 'axial' | 'scaledRadial';

interface StickZone {
    readonly kind: 'stick';

    readonly vector: readonly [number, number];
    readonly x: number;
    readonly y: number;
    readonly originX: number;
    readonly originY: number;
}

interface StickZoneOptions {
    kind: 'stick';

    deadZone?: number;
    radius?: number;
    anchor?: 'down' | 'center';
}

## SwipeDirection  (type-only)
type SwipeDirection = 'left' | 'right' | 'up' | 'down';

## SwipeZone  (type-only)
interface SwipeZone {
    readonly kind: 'swipe';

    readonly swipe: SwipeDirection | null;

## TouchZoneBinding  (type-only)
type TouchZoneBinding<Z extends string = string> =
{
    zone: Z;
    axis: 'x' | 'y';
    dir: 1 | -1;
}
 | {
    zone: Z;
    button: string;
}
 | {
    zone: Z;
    swipe: SwipeDirection;
};

## TouchZoneKind  (type-only)
type TouchZoneKind = 'stick' | 'buttons' | 'swipe';

## TouchZoneOptions  (type-only)
type TouchZoneOptions = StickZoneOptions | ButtonsZoneOptions | SwipeZoneOptions;

## TouchZoneReading  (type-only)
type TouchZoneReading<O extends TouchZoneOptions> = O extends StickZoneOptions ? StickZone : O extends ButtonsZoneOptions ? ButtonsZone : SwipeZone;

## TouchZones  (type-only)
interface TouchZones<Z extends Record<string, TouchZoneOptions>> {
    readonly zones: {
        readonly [K in keyof Z]: TouchZoneReading<Z[K]>;
    };
    enabled: boolean;
    update(): void;
    attach(): void;
    detach(): void;
    destroy(): void;
}

## TouchZonesOptions  (type-only)
interface TouchZonesOptions<Z extends Record<string, TouchZoneOptions>, A extends string = string> {
    zones: Z;
    bindings?: Partial<Record<A, TouchZoneBinding<keyof Z & string> | readonly TouchZoneBinding<keyof Z & string>[]>>;
    devices?: readonly PointerRecordDevice[];
}
